tooltip: Standing attack damage 1228% x1, max 4 hits Forward attack damage 1228% x1, max 3 hits Lateral attack damage 1228% x1, max 1 hits Sprint attack damage 1228% x1 Casting Speed +5% for 10 sec when using standing, forward, 2nd lateral, and sprint attacks
